dedupe_keys.name: meteo france basic climatological data ten day agrometeorological series decadaires agro

description: Ten-day agrometeorological data from all French weather stations. The data.gouv.fr page says the dataset gives measured or computed ten-day values since each station opened, for metropolitan and overseas France: precipitation, mean wind speed, mean minimum and maximum temperature, mean vapour pressure, global radiation, sunshine duration and FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration, after climatological quality control. It is a free download by department and period as compressed CSV (316 files) under the Licence Ouverte 2.0, updated yearly for pre-1950 files, monthly for later history and daily for the last two years; the listing was updated on 26 September 2026. Coverage is France and overseas territories. Caveats: station records differ in length. For simulation it gives evapotranspiration and rainfall to drive crop water balance and irrigation demand models. A related catalogue record is the Drought.gov standardized drought indices.
